basics.name: Andor Sípos
basics.label: Founder, Technical Lead & Software Architect
basics.summary: Software architect and technical lead with 13+ years of experience building business .NET systems. As founder and technical lead of operandor, he designs the structure of each solution, coordinates the developers' work and writes code himself. He is at home in large, long-lived codebases and modernises them step by step into a modular structure while they stay in production. Recent work combines .NET and Azure with AI-assisted workflows, from Azure OpenAI document extraction to an MCP server for coding agents, alongside TypeScript/React front ends.

work.name: operandor
work.summary: Software development business that builds custom business applications, connects and modernises existing systems, and automates repetitive work, bringing in AI where the task and the data make it worthwhile. Its services are custom software development, system integration, taking over an existing system, system modernisation, AI-assisted workflow automation and senior developer capacity; its own product, rovatix, extracts data from documents.
highlights: Leads the technical work: designs the structure of each solution, coordinates the developers and takes part in development and technical reviews.

Works remotely with clients' existing teams, agreeing tasks, availability and responsibilities before the work starts, and brings in experienced developers he has worked with before for larger pieces of work.
Leads the development of rovatix, which reads data from PDFs, scanned documents and photos and, after a human check, passes it on in an agreed format; it is offered as a demo and an agreed pilot.

Built operandor.io, a four-language website, with Blazor WebAssembly and an Azure Functions API following Clean Architecture, tested with xUnit and deployed to Azure Static Web Apps through GitHub Actions.

work.name: ALLWIN Informatika Kft.
work.summary: Consultancy delivery across eCommerce, GIS, public sector and R&D projects, with lead engineer and architect responsibilities from 2021.
highlights: Took on lead engineer and architect responsibilities from 2021.
Delivered projects for a large enterprise, the public sector, an international vessel-tracking client and a German gaming company, plus an R&D project from a winning tender.

work.name: Grape Solutions Kft.
highlights: Worked on a hospital BI system built to Hungarian regulatory requirements, including MOLAP cube construction, KPI definition and a web portal for data upload and visualisation.
Developed an internal portal for an international pharmaceutical company to manage active substances.
Developed a website for an international hunting association documenting game records.

work.name: Regatta Project Kft.
highlights: Developed multi-layered manufacturing tracking software for a ceramics manufacturer.
Developed bespoke multi-layered ERP and stock management software for an international quality assurance company.

projects.name: Modernisation of a mortgage and property transaction platform
projects.description: Business-critical platform used by lenders and law firms to manage mortgage and property transaction processes, including complex panel and workflow processes. Responsible for modernising the codebase and for architectural direction, with scalability, compliance and transparency as the driving constraints; played a key role in defining the development strategy and in selecting team members.
highlights: Reshaped a tightly coupled .NET Framework system, built on WCF and stored procedures, step by step into modular monoliths with Clean Architecture while it stayed in production throughout.

Delivered a reusable access-control module, later adopted by three of the client's other products, and a reporting module fed by Azure Data Factory; the two modules were then used to build a new product.
Delivered an Azure Functions service that used Azure OpenAI to extract structured data from uploaded documents as JSON and persist it directly in the production database.

Built an internal MCP server that lets AI coding agents retrieve relevant codebase and project context from work item descriptions, using lexical, domain-specific retrieval tuned to the project's terminology.
Introduced a testing framework covering the full testing pyramid, with unit, integration and end-to-end tests accompanying both the modernisation and new features.
Owned design and code reviews, mentored engineers and onboarded new joiners onto the large legacy codebase as the team grew from 3 to 7–8 people.
Handled escalated production issues on the business-critical system, from investigation through root cause analysis to remediation.
Used GitHub Copilot, Claude and Cursor daily as part of the team's development workflow.

projects.name: Insurance agency management SaaS
projects.description: SaaS product for smaller insurance agencies, covering lead and opportunity management, carrier communication and accounting support, designed to scale as an agency grows.
highlights: Built a feasibility demo of the product for a prospective enterprise client.

projects.name: Test reports for an accredited laboratory
projects.description: A .NET application that helped an accredited materials testing laboratory prepare its test records and reports.
highlights: Developed test record and report features in .NET with DevExpress on a SQL Server database.

projects.name: Supplier reporting platform
projects.description: Internal supply chain BI platform for an international manufacturer, surfacing the organisation's main KPIs on a dashboard: decision-makers and business leaders saw in one place how suppliers confirmed forecasts and how this affected production.
highlights: Owned technical delivery across back end, front end and deployment, first as full-stack engineer and then as tech lead of a distributed team of 3–4 people.

Built and maintained the TypeScript/React/MUI front end consuming the BI dashboard's APIs, where leaders filtered figures by business unit, region and supplier and compared successive forecasts part by part.
Worked on an ASP.NET Core monolith following Clean Architecture, with AWS Lambda functions loading supplier data into a PostgreSQL star schema for the reports.
Owned CI/CD across Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions, with containerised deployment on Docker and Kubernetes.
Provided technical guidance and code review for the engineering team across several time zones.

projects.description: Online store built on the nopCommerce open-source platform.
highlights: Extended a large third-party .NET codebase through nopCommerce's plugin architecture, without forking it or changing the core application's source code.

x-strengths.title: Modernisation without stopping production
x-strengths.summary: Reshapes large, tightly coupled .NET systems step by step into modular monoliths with Clean Architecture while they stay in production, most recently a .NET Framework, WCF and stored-procedure platform used by lenders and law firms.

x-strengths.title: Technical leadership of small remote teams
x-strengths.summary: Designs the structure of the solution, coordinates developers, runs design and code reviews, mentors and onboards engineers, and acts as the primary technical contact for client stakeholders, most recently in a team that grew from 3 to 7–8 people.

x-strengths.title: Clean Architecture and modular design
x-strengths.summary: Starts new systems from a clean, modular design with clear module boundaries, and builds modules that other products can reuse, such as an access-control module adopted by three further products.

x-strengths.title: AI-assisted development and document processing
x-strengths.summary: Uses GitHub Copilot, Claude and Cursor daily, built an MCP server that gives coding agents codebase and project context, and delivered Azure OpenAI-based extraction of structured data from documents into a production database.

x-strengths.title: Full-stack .NET and TypeScript/React delivery
x-strengths.summary: Delivers end to end with C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework and SQL Server or PostgreSQL on the back end, TypeScript, React and MUI on the front end, and CI/CD through Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions to Azure, AWS and Kubernetes.

x-strengths.title: Root-cause debugging in long-lived codebases
x-strengths.summary: Investigates complex defects and escalated production issues in large, long-lived codebases, traces them back to their root cause, and pragmatically removes the technical debt and single points of failure behind them.
